entries.title: Add production managed-agent adoption script
entries.rationale: Reject for Zion intake: the script mutates installed production and development agent stores, reads keychain identity material, writes a private identity key, and performs an atomic data migration across environments. It is an operational migration requiring a separately authorized runbook, not source intake; do not run it.
security_reasons: reads and migrates credential-bearing identity material
cross-environment adoption can alter agent ownership and authorization
verification: Full-SHA script diff, file/keychain access, production mutation scope, visible branding, and operational authorization boundary reviewed; no source implementation made and script not run.
